subject.title: feat: align native macOS chat with the web chat capability set

question: Should assistant reasoning and tool traces become enabled by default for existing macOS users who have no stored preference?
rationale: The PR intentionally changes an existing user's default visible chat behavior, and tests cannot determine whether that upgrade policy matches maintainer product intent.

options.title: Keep Upgrade Default Off
options.body: Default traces to hidden unless the user enables them, preserving existing macOS behavior while retaining the new toggle.

options.title: Accept Default On
options.body: Keep the proposed enabled default and explicitly accept that existing users will see reasoning and tool activity after upgrade.

options.title: Separate Default Policy
options.body: Land the capability wiring only after moving the default-on policy into a smaller independently reviewed change.

recommendation.title: Keep Upgrade Default Off
recommendation.body: Default traces to hidden unless the user enables them, preserving existing macOS behavior while retaining the new toggle.

likelyOwner.reason: The available context routes this native-chat feature and its preference design through steipete, although current-main ownership history is incomplete.
